notes.title: Save big with the biggest discounts ever!
notes.notes:
For one week starting Nov 27, enjoy the biggest discounts on my games ever! Up to 90% off for Ashmedai, if you have avoided her until now. Zuri's got a 80% discount, with a matching discount on the dlc! Give the whole assortment a look and buy what ya like.

Oh, and there's a new game out too, be sure to grab that while your shopping!

notes.title: Don't worry, we are alive and kicking! Pricing Updates and more
One Year Anniversary Sale
notes.notes:
April 29th will mark my one year Steam Anniversary, so this week enjoy my games at their lowest prices yet! 

Don't be confused by the percentages, most of the games had permanent price reductions a few weeks ago, so while the discounts may not seem as high as they were during the last sale, the end result is still cheaper. 

And due to technical difficulties, the art collection for Legend of Zuri will start it's sale a day later than the rest of the collection...

Thanks again, and stay tuned for what's coming in the future.

notes.title: Bacon Quest Now Available on Steam
notes.notes:
Bacon Quest is now live on Steam and has a 10% discount for launch week!

Enjoy a light-hearted dungeon-crawler with lots of ecchi action without breaking the bank. Explore a raunchy world with the curvy succubus Syren and her cute friend Aoi. Fight your way through several voluptuous enemies while unlocking the 64 images in the CG gallery.

Don't disappoint the smexy succubus Syren or her trusty friend Aoi! 

Be sure to look out for our future releases in the coming months featuring more deviant adventures!
